events.result: Recovered 9 October monograph version 3 with completed proofreading report. Earlier catalogue uncertainty was a retrieval gap, not an absent mathematical result.
FAIL for per-page extracted text of the 94-page Lean guide. Sixteen pages reflowed across boundaries. Complete ordered body text was unchanged. Original report retained.
All final pages rendered and reviewed. Rebuilt PDFs refrozen. Second isolated replay reproduced all three byte for byte.
Removed inaccurate hardcoded pytest-unavailable wording from direct-run helper. Pytest mode now verifies measured JUnit collection/pass/failure/skip counts.

A dangling bibtex command was bypassed with the available bibtex.original fallback. Compatible local fonts are resolved without redistribution. DejaVu Sans Mono differed only in FFTM/checksum metadata; its meaningful table fingerprint matched.

An interactive shell session was unsupported, and one direct long build call timed out. Successful replacement invocations were polled to completion and logged. A timed-out invocation is not counted as passing build evidence.
No overfull boxes, missing-glyph messages or undefined references. Benign underfull boxes and unicode-math command-override warnings retained.
